description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic for configuring the voice talk mode settings in an application. It includes a state struct (`TalkModeGatewayConfigState`) that holds configuration parameters and a parser enum (`TalkModeGatewayConfigParser`) that processes a dictionary-based configuration into this state.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a configuration dictionary into a `TalkModeGatewayConfigState` object, applying defaults and processing nested configurations.
